name: DeMiguel et al. (2020) characteristic tilt, S_k5 (linear turnover penalty, kappa = 5)
status_note: Not a holdout candidate for now (CoS, 2026-10-04). Tracked forward as research only.

source.document: Quant stage-2 holdout pre-registration, Addendum 2 (section 7, CIO Book rule)

book_rule.test: One-way turnover at most 100% a year on the dev window
CAGR minus the static core's CAGR stays above 0 with costs doubled to 10 bp one-way
book_rule.core_basis: stand-in static core 70% IVV / 20% QQQ / 10% IJR (Addendum 2 benchmark list)

cost_convention: The dev engine charged 5 bp per unit of two-way (L1) turnover, which is 10 bp one-way. Turnover figures quoted earlier (e.g. 355%/yr) were two-way; one-way is half of that (178%/yr for S_k5). The holdout charges 5 bp one-way.
fix_variants_note: All three fix variants (S_q_cv, S_ridge_cv, S_q_ridge_cv) also fail rules (a) and (b).
